in_marathi.name: Ishvar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishvar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishvar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ish', meaning rule or reign. The name Ishvar signifies the supreme ruler, the Lord, or God. In Hindu mythology, Ishvar is often referred to as the creator of the universe and the ruler of all beings.
